metadata.description: Reproducibility archive and tooling for two NeurIPS 2026 workshop papers on how language models weigh conflicting and incrementally delivered clinical evidence: (1) "Stable Decisions Can Hide Evidence Sensitivity in Life-Science Evidence Synthesis" (AgenticLS: Life-Science Agents Workshop, NeurIPS 2026) and (2) "Evidence Is Not a Vote: Categorical Stability and Confidence Sensitivity Under Conflicting Clinical Evidence" (GenAI4Health workshop, NeurIPS 2026; title as in the anonymized submission, camera-ready pending). Includes frozen runners and analysis code, reported analysis outputs, provenance manifests, validation tooling and tests. Restricted source-derived data, provider model outputs and paper PDFs are not included. Known provenance limitation: the archived post-hoc analysis manifest records an earlier script hash that is no longer available; the recovered script regenerates all archived post-hoc outputs byte-for-byte under the verified reproduction environment (SciPy 1.16.3).
